subject: Detection history per picture instead per day

messages.author: a62efa68f173d4f8
messages.subject: Detection history per picture instead per day
parts:
Is it possible to create a detection history output with presence/ absence of a species in each picture instead in each day? Each row would represent a camera and each column would be a picture. 
Thanks!

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: Detection history per picture instead per day
parts:
Hi Inés,
this is not implemented in the package. You could probably write some simple code in R to achieve this, like:

  1. subset record table to species of interest
  2. create a matrix with all unique stations (or cameras) as rows and all image filenames as columns, all values are NA. (it will be a very big matrix!)
  3. Based on the record table, find all images at a given station (or camera), write value 1 to the corresponding matrix cells.
  4. repeat for all stations

Just wondering, what kind of analysis would you use that data format for? 
Best,
Jürgen
